name: bias-detection-mcp
description: AI Bias Detection and Fairness Assessment for AI agents. Capabilities: quick bias scan, demographic bias detection, fairness metrics, mitigation recommendations, regulatory compliance. Built by MEOK AI Labs.

tools.name: quick_scan
tools.description: Describe an AI system, get instant bias risk assessment. No API key required.

tools.name: detect_bias
tools.description: Analyze text for demographic bias patterns, stereotyping, and unfair language.

tools.name: fairness_metrics
tools.description: Calculate fairness metrics from prediction data.

tools.name: mitigation_recommendations
tools.description: Get detailed remediation steps for a specific type of AI bias.

tools.name: regulatory_check
tools.description: Check bias requirements against EU AI Act Article 10 and NIST AI RMF.
